name: 0.1.0-beta.5
notes:
# Folian 0.1.0 beta 5

This beta tightens the production update path and model catalogue before the paid beta release candidate.

- Uses `config.folian.app` as the desktop update feed and remote AI model catalogue source.
- Corrects the public AI model catalogue to verified provider model IDs.
- Keeps the stable desktop channel inactive until Folian publishes a real stable release.
- Protects partial project setting updates from clearing omitted project fields.
- Keeps local writing projects, encrypted API keys, exports and backups separate from application updates.

Application updates replace only Folian itself. Your writing data remains in the separate Folian data folder.
